# Objective

Apply the four verified third-round review findings as one fix batch,
keeping the suite green and the documented policies in sync.

# Verified findings (all reproduced before fixing)

1. Backup cleanup ran inside the rollback scope: a failed backup `unlink`
   after a fully successful publication triggered full rollback, deleting
   the committed outputs and failing to restore the already-deleted
   backups (every final file destroyed, `a.bam` unrecoverable).
2. Candidate truncation kept only the leftmost
   `--max-candidates-per-read` occurrences; when the BAM placement fell
   beyond the cap it left the pair-search pool (overlap 12 became 4, merge
   lost vs `--candidate-source bam`).
3. Stale-tag removal only ran when coordinates changed; a MAPQ-only change
   left `MQ:i:60` next to an adjusted MAPQ of 3.
4. `check_pair_flags` validated records in isolation, so duplicate primary
   read1 records passed and silently overwrote each other in the
   processing slot.

# Changes as executed

- `src/pairloom/pipeline.py`:
  - commit point after the publish loop; backup removal is post-commit
    housekeeping — failure collects leftovers, warns on stderr, exits 0
    with committed outputs preserved;
  - `_sync_mate_fields` sets reciprocal `MQ` from the adjusted MAPQs;
  - `_adjust_single` removes `MQ` on the mapped record of an orphan,
    refreshes it on the unmapped mate, and drops it for lone records.
- `src/pairloom/candidates.py`: when truncation drops the BAM placement,
  the last kept slot is reserved for it (cap honored, truncation flag
  unchanged).
- `src/pairloom/records.py`: `check_pair_flags` counts read1/read2 slots
  and rejects duplicates with `DataInvariantError`; module docstring
  updated.
- Tests: 6 regressions added (cleanup preservation with stderr-warning
  assert, truncated-candidate merge parity, MQ refresh on unchanged and
  moved placements, orphan MQ semantics, duplicate read-number rejection).
  Suite 137 → 143. One batch-2 expectation deliberately updated: moved
  tagged reads now carry a refreshed `MQ` (== adjusted mate MAPQ) instead
  of no tag.
- README: duplicate-read-number invariant, original-placement slot in
  candidate discovery, the `MQ` exception in the adjusted-records
  paragraph, commit-point behavior in the failure policy, test count.

# Steps actually taken

1. Plan written; all four findings re-verified via the evaluation turn's
   reproduction script.
2. Fixes applied (pipeline commit point + MQ, candidates slot, records
   duplicate check); one batch-2 test updated to the new MQ policy; suite
   green.
3. Six regressions added; ruff format applied to two test files; full
   gates re-run.
4. Reproduction script re-run at the original bug sites: all four
   behaviors corrected; benchmark re-measured.

# Verification

- `pixi run test`: 143 passed (was 137; +6 regressions).
- Reproduction re-run: cleanup failure exits 0 with outputs present and
  the leftover backup reported; the 444/452 pair merges at the original
  placement (28M, MAPQ 3) with bam-only parity; `mapq=3 MQ=3`; duplicate
  R1s exit 1 with no published output.
- `pixi run lint` / `pixi run format`: clean.
- Benchmark: 1 thread 7.8 s / 2,562 pairs/s / 225 MiB — ~3% below the
  previous runs, consistent with the two added `MQ` writes per template
  plus run variance; within the documented 2.6–4.2k range.

# Risks encountered

- None beyond the two confirmed design decisions (commit-point semantics;
  set-not-remove `MQ`), both documented in README and the report.
